Reservation.title: Reservation
Reservation.description: Table or banquet hall booking submitted by a restaurant guest and managed by restaurant admins.

name.description: Guest full name or first name.

phone.description: Formatted phone number provided by the guest.

phoneNormalized.description: Digits-only phone identifier used to group CRM guest profiles.

hallTitle.description: Display title of the selected hall.

date.description: Requested booking date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time.description: Requested arrival time in HH:MM format.

notes.description: Optional special requests from the guest.

adminNote.description: Internal manager note visible only in Admin Panel & CRM.

telegramTarget.description: Telegram handler username for booking inquiries.

handledByEmail.description: Email of the last admin who updated the reservation status.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Admin access record keyed by lowercase verified Google email with granular panel and management permissions.

email.description: Lowercase Google account email address matching the document ID.

canAccessPanel.description: Permission to sign into and view the Admin Panel, bookings, CRM, and statistics.

canManageBookings.description: Permission to update reservation statuses, edit notes, delete bookings, and edit CRM profiles.

canManageAdmins.description: Permission to add, edit permissions of, or remove administrator accounts.

addedBy.description: Email of the super-admin or admin manager who added this record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when permissions were last updated.

CustomerCrm.title: CustomerCrm
CustomerCrm.description: Persistent CRM customer profile keyed by normalized phone digits storing VIP tags and manager notes.

phoneNormalized.description: Digits-only customer phone matching the document ID.

tags.description: Bounded list (max 10) of CRM tags such as VIP, Doimiy mijoz, or Banket.

crmNote.description: Persistent manager CRM note about guest preferences.

updatedByEmail.description: Email of the admin who last updated this CRM profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when CRM record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when CRM record was last updated.

/reservations/{reservationId}.description: Guest table/hall reservations. Publicly creatable with strict field and initial-state validation; readable and manageable only by authorized admins.

/admins/{adminEmail}.description: Administrator directory keyed by lowercase email address with granular panel, booking-management, and admin-management permissions.

/customers/{customerId}.description: Persistent CRM profiles for repeat guests keyed by digits-only phone number.
